netlist:
ce_ac
Vcc supply 0 12
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 1m 1k)
Cin in base 10u
Rtop supply base 100k
Rbottom base 0 22k
Rc supply out 2.2k
Re1 emitter bypass 100
Re2 bypass 0 900
Ce bypass 0 100u
Q1 out base emitter q
.model q NPN(IS=1e-15 BF=150 BR=3 VAF=100 VAR=30 IKF=50m RB=40 RC=2 RE=1 CJE=20p CJC=8p TF=400p TR=20n)
.options reltol=1e-6 vntol=1e-9
.ac dec 3 10 10k
.control
set numdgt=15
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
run
let value0 = mag(v(out))
let value1 = 180/pi*vp(out)
wrdata reference.dat value0 value1
quit
.endc
.end
